motion_fx_motion_fx_scrolling.comment: Master switch for every scroll effect below. "yes" to enable, "" to disable.

motion_fx_translateY_effect.comment: Vertical Scroll. "yes" enables, "" disables. Needs motion_fx_motion_fx_scrolling = "yes".

motion_fx_translateY_speed.comment: Slider object, NOT a number — {"size":4,"unit":"px","sizes":[]}. px range 0–10 step 0.1. Higher is faster.

motion_fx_translateY_affectedRange.comment: Viewport range object — {"size":"","unit":"%","sizes":{"start":0,"end":100}}. start/end are percentages of the scroll pass over which the effect plays.

motion_fx_translateX_effect.comment: Horizontal Scroll. "yes" enables, "" disables. Needs motion_fx_motion_fx_scrolling = "yes".

motion_fx_translateX_speed.comment: Slider object, NOT a number — {"size":4,"unit":"px","sizes":[]}. px range 0–10 step 0.1. Higher is faster.

motion_fx_translateX_affectedRange.comment: Viewport range object — {"size":"","unit":"%","sizes":{"start":0,"end":100}}. start/end are percentages of the scroll pass over which the effect plays.

motion_fx_opacity_direction.comment: Transparency direction. One of "out-in", "in-out", "in-out-in", "out-in-out" — where in the viewport the effect runs.

motion_fx_opacity_level.comment: Slider object, NOT a number — {"size":7,"unit":"px","sizes":[]}. px range 1–10 step 0.1. 10 fades fully, 1 barely at all.

motion_fx_opacity_range.comment: Viewport range object — {"size":"","unit":"%","sizes":{"start":0,"end":100}}. start/end are percentages of the scroll pass over which the effect plays.

motion_fx_blur_direction.comment: Blur direction. One of "out-in", "in-out", "in-out-in", "out-in-out" — where in the viewport the effect runs.

motion_fx_blur_level.comment: Slider object, NOT a number — {"size":7,"unit":"px","sizes":[]}. px range 1–15 step 1.

motion_fx_blur_range.comment: Viewport range object — {"size":"","unit":"%","sizes":{"start":0,"end":100}}. start/end are percentages of the scroll pass over which the effect plays.

motion_fx_rotateZ_speed.comment: Slider object, NOT a number — {"size":4,"unit":"px","sizes":[]}. px range 0–10 step 0.1. Higher is faster.

motion_fx_rotateZ_affectedRange.comment: Viewport range object — {"size":"","unit":"%","sizes":{"start":0,"end":100}}. start/end are percentages of the scroll pass over which the effect plays.

motion_fx_scale_direction.comment: Scale direction. One of "out-in", "in-out", "in-out-in", "out-in-out" — where in the viewport the effect runs.

motion_fx_scale_speed.comment: Slider object, NOT a number — {"size":4,"unit":"px","sizes":[]}. px range -10–10 step 1. Higher is faster. Negative shrinks instead of grows.

motion_fx_scale_range.comment: Viewport range object — {"size":"","unit":"%","sizes":{"start":0,"end":100}}. start/end are percentages of the scroll pass over which the effect plays.

motion_fx_transform_origin_x.comment: X anchor point for Rotate and Scale — "left", "center" or "right".

motion_fx_transform_origin_y.comment: Y anchor point for Rotate and Scale — "top", "center" or "bottom".

motion_fx_devices.comment: Which breakpoints run the scroll effects. Array of breakpoints, any of "desktop", "tablet_extra", "tablet", "mobile_extra", "mobile". An empty array means nowhere.

motion_fx_range.comment: What the effect is measured against — "" = default, "viewport", or "page".

motion_fx_motion_fx_mouse.comment: Master switch for the two mouse effects below. "yes" to enable, "" to disable.

motion_fx_mouseTrack_effect.comment: Mouse Track. "yes" enables, "" disables. Needs motion_fx_motion_fx_mouse = "yes".

motion_fx_mouseTrack_direction.comment: Mouse Track direction. "" = default direction, "negative" = reversed.

motion_fx_mouseTrack_speed.comment: Slider object, NOT a number — {"size":4,"unit":"px","sizes":[]}. px range 0–10 step 0.1. Higher is faster.

motion_fx_tilt_speed.comment: Slider object, NOT a number — {"size":4,"unit":"px","sizes":[]}. px range 0–10 step 0.1. Higher is faster.

sticky.comment: Stick to "top" or "bottom". "" is not sticky.

sticky_on.comment: Which breakpoints stick. Array of breakpoints, any of "desktop", "tablet_extra", "tablet", "mobile_extra", "mobile". An empty array means nowhere.

sticky_offset.comment: Distance in px from the edge it sticks to. Number.

sticky_offset_tablet_extra.comment: Sticky Offset on Tablet Extra. Number, or "" to inherit.

sticky_offset_tablet.comment: Sticky Offset on Tablet. Number, or "" to inherit.

sticky_offset_mobile_extra.comment: Sticky Offset on Mobile Extra. Number, or "" to inherit.

sticky_offset_mobile.comment: Sticky Offset on Mobile. Number, or "" to inherit.

sticky_effects_offset.comment: How far past the sticky point before scroll effects start, in px. Number.

sticky_effects_offset_tablet_extra.comment: Effects Offset on Tablet Extra. Number, or "" to inherit.

sticky_effects_offset_tablet.comment: Effects Offset on Tablet. Number, or "" to inherit.

sticky_effects_offset_mobile_extra.comment: Effects Offset on Mobile Extra. Number, or "" to inherit.

sticky_effects_offset_mobile.comment: Effects Offset on Mobile. Number, or "" to inherit.

sticky_anchor_link_offset.comment: Extra px an anchor link leaves above this element while sticky. Number.

sticky_anchor_link_offset_tablet_extra.comment: Anchor Offset on Tablet Extra. Number, or "" to inherit.

sticky_anchor_link_offset_tablet.comment: Anchor Offset on Tablet. Number, or "" to inherit.

sticky_anchor_link_offset_mobile_extra.comment: Anchor Offset on Mobile Extra. Number, or "" to inherit.

sticky_anchor_link_offset_mobile.comment: Anchor Offset on Mobile. Number, or "" to inherit.

sticky_parent.comment: "yes" keeps it stuck only while its parent is on screen. "" lets it stick for the whole page.

animation.comment: Entrance animation. "" = Default (whatever the theme does), "none", or one of: fadeIn fadeInDown fadeInLeft fadeInRight fadeInUp · zoomIn zoomInDown zoomInLeft zoomInRight zoomInUp · bounceIn bounceInDown bounceInLeft bounceInRight bounceInUp · slideInDown slideInLeft slideInRight slideInUp · rotateIn rotateInDownLeft rotateInDownRight rotateInUpLeft rotateInUpRight · bounce flash pulse rubberBand shake headShake swing tada wobble jello · lightSpeedIn · rollIn

animation_tablet_extra.comment: Entrance animation on Tablet Extra. Same values as `animation`.

animation_tablet.comment: Entrance animation on Tablet. Same values as `animation`.

animation_mobile_extra.comment: Entrance animation on Mobile Extra. Same values as `animation`.

animation_mobile.comment: Entrance animation on Mobile. Same values as `animation`.

animation_delay.comment: Delay before the entrance animation, in ms. Number. This is the field Delay Accumulation adds to — with several layers shift-clicked, layer N gets this value plus (accumulation × (N-1)).
